list.heading: Apps

list.emptyDescription: Install a web server below before creating sites.

setup.heading: Set up this server
setup.subtitle: Choose the web server that will serve your sites, and the runtimes they need. Nothing is installed until you confirm.

webServer.hint: Exactly one web server serves your sites. Switching later means removing this one first, which needs every site removed.
webServer.none: This server's package sources offer no web server.

runtimes.hint: Optional. Sites can only use a runtime that is installed; more can be added later from the app store.
runtimes.none: This server's package sources offer no runtime.

review.noRuntimes: None. Add runtimes later from the app store.

setup.installingNotice: Installing. Keep this page open; it may take several minutes.
setup.doneDescription: A web server is installed. You can create sites now.
setup.needWebServer: The web server could not be installed, so sites cannot be created yet. Try again.
setup.loadFailed: The apps this server can install could not be read.

pending.heading: Panel is being set up
pending.title: This panel is being set up
